review.why: Gets cited web research on disk: an approved plan, parallel subtopic searches and a report with quoted sources.
review.summary: Takes a finished research question, writes a plan with one to five subtopics, asks the user to approve it, dispatches up to three search subagents, and synthesizes a report with TL;DR, findings, gaps and a numbered source list. Every citation carries URL, title and a verbatim excerpt; failures are recorded rather than hidden.
strengths: Hard gates evidenced by files on disk, not by an internal claim
Honest Gaps & Limitations section, including failed subagents
Never invents citation metadata such as retrieval dates
cautions: Treats the question as final: it will not sharpen a vague one
Built to be called by other skills of the same collection; the contract references them
